_doc: Per-clip in-points and crop centres, MEASURED from the footage rather than
defaulted. Without this a cutaway starts at 0.1s and centre-crops, which put
a globe over North America on the line 'the UK and parts of Europe', and cut
the approval stamp before the mark appeared.
Match is on a substring of the filename (lowercased).
src_in  : seconds into the clip where the subject of the shot is READABLE
crop_x  : left edge of the 608px vertical crop, centred on the region of
why     : how the number was arrived at, so it can be re-checked

hints.why: clip opens on a globe over North America; the UK reveal runs 4.0-7.0s - highlight fades in, label lands ~5.0s, then a slow zoom holds. UK silhouette centres at x=909, so crop 909-304=605.

green APPROVED mark is readable on the form from 4.3s and holds. crop_x 620 keeps the mark fully inside the 608px frame and excludes the red REJECTED stamp, which contradicts this positive beat. (946 clipped the 'A' off APPROVED.)
